evidence.quote: Decision: the e2e suite asserts that saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer.

observations.why: The word 'Decision:' performs the settling — a performed declarative ratifying a settled, load-bearing position the speaker expects others to act on.

evidence.quote: This probe memory exists only to carry that assertion.

observations.why: A flat unhedged assertion about the probe's purpose — committed but not ratification language; the claim/decision boundary falls on the lower side since no performed settling is present.
